XAG P150 MAX — one platform, three jobs

Spraying. Spreading. Cargo.

  1. 01

    Spraying

    80 L

    Spray tank

    Precise spraying across a 5–10 m swath, with two pumps delivering up to 32 L/min. With the additional 4-nozzle upgrade kit, up to 46 L/min for orchards and vineyards.

  2. 02

    Granule spreading

    115 L

    Granule container

    Fertiliser, seed and other granules, up to 9 m effective width.

  3. 03

    Cargo transport

    80 kg

    Max payload

    Deliver materials and equipment to hard-to-reach places.
